name: Digital Analytics Program
description: Adds the GSA Digital Analytics Program JavaScript to pages.
project_description: This module integrates the U.S. Government's Digital Analytics Program (DAP) JavaScript, provided by the General Services Administration (GSA) at digital.gov. Once installed, navigate to /admin/config/services/dap and configure the settings. At a minimum you must set a value for the Agency before the JavaScript is attached to pages. The script can be served from the DAP CDN (https://dap.digitalgov.gov/Universal-Federated-Analytics-Min.js, the default) or from local copies bundled with the module (versions 8.0.0, 8.5.0, 8.6.0, minified or not). The module appends the configured DAP options (agency, subagency, site topic/platform, search-parameter and download tracking, YouTube/HTML5 video tracking, sub-domain and cookie settings, and parallel Google Analytics 4 reporting with custom-dimension slots) as a query string on the script URL. Prior to the 3.x branch the module was named "US Fed Government Google Analytics"; the 3.x rewrite brought it up to DAP version 8.5.0 standards and changed the configuration schema, so settings must be reviewed after upgrading. Initial development was performed by Blackstone Technology Group for DHS.
